vars.label: Public housing developments (HUD)
vars.definition: Public housing developments in HUD's list, in the municipio HUD gives for each (the county of the development's main building). A development can be one building or several scattered across a community.

vars.label: Public housing units (HUD)
vars.definition: Dwelling units in those developments, as HUD reports them (TOTAL_UNITS). Occupied and vacant units are both counted.

vars.label: LIHTC projects (HUD)
vars.ref: HUD National LIHTC Database, projects placed in service 1987 to 2024 (release of 2026-04-30)
vars.definition: Projects placed in service with Low-Income Housing Tax Credits, as the Puerto Rico Housing Finance Authority reported them to HUD, in the municipio of each project (the county of its 2020 census tract, or the city HUD lists). A project counts from the year it was placed in service, including the few no longer monitored for the credit's rules.

vars.label: LIHTC housing units (HUD)
vars.ref: HUD National LIHTC Database, projects placed in service 1987 to 2024 (release of 2026-04-30)
vars.definition: Housing units in those projects, as HUD reports them (N_UNITS), low-income and market-rate together.

vars.label: LIHTC low-income units (HUD)
vars.ref: HUD National LIHTC Database, projects placed in service 1987 to 2024 (release of 2026-04-30)
vars.definition: The units in those projects that are rent- and income-restricted under the credit (LI_UNITS), as the allocating agency reported them.

vars.label: Fire and EMS stations (USGS)
vars.ref: USGS National Structures Dataset, loaded up to 2026-07-17
vars.definition: Fire stations and emergency medical service stations in the USGS National Structures Dataset, in the municipio that holds each point.

vars.label: Police stations (OpenStreetMap)
vars.definition: Police stations and other police facilities mapped in OpenStreetMap (amenity=police), in the municipio that holds each point. A station mapped twice (a point and its building, same name, within 30 m) counts once. Volunteers map them, so a missing station is possible.

vars.label: Public libraries (USAC E-Rate)
vars.ref: USAC E-Rate Supplemental Entity Information, updated 2026-11-07
vars.definition: Active libraries registered for the federal E-Rate program that USAC marks as public libraries, in the municipio of their address. In Puerto Rico the list includes community technology centres and other community libraries registered as public libraries, not only municipal libraries.

hud_public_housing.name: HUD — Public Housing Developments (eGIS open data)
hud_public_housing.license: U.S. Public Domain (HUD open data catalog)
hud_public_housing.note: One point per public housing development. The observatory publishes the development's name, type, units, municipio and point, never the housing authority's telephone, e-mail or director, nor the tenants' figures.

hud_lihtc.name: HUD — National Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) Database
hud_lihtc.license: US Government work (17 U.S.C. 105: no copyright in the United States); HUD USER states no other licence for the database
hud_lihtc.note: Every LIHTC project placed in service in Puerto Rico that the Puerto Rico Housing Finance Authority reported to HUD. The observatory publishes each drawn project's name, municipio, units, low-income units, year placed in service and point, never its street address; projects for people who are homeless or living with HIV, and care homes for older adults, are counted, not drawn or named.

usgs_structures.name: USGS — The National Map, National Structures Dataset
usgs_structures.note: Fire and EMS stations of Puerto Rico. The observatory publishes each station's name, type, municipio and point, not its address.

osm.name: OpenStreetMap
osm.note: Police stations as volunteers mapped them (amenity=police), read through the Overpass API. The observatory publishes each one's name, type, municipio and point, not its address, telephone or website.

usac_erate.name: USAC — E-Rate Supplemental Entity Information (open data)
usac_erate.note: Libraries registered for the E-Rate program that USAC marks as public libraries. The observatory publishes each library's name, type, municipio and point, never its contacts, telephone, e-mail or address.
